_about.purpose: Fixture for the Porchlight demo. Authored, not sampled — see IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §6.7. No public dataset contains multiple free-text descriptions of the same event by different reporters, because intake operators normalize that away at collection; normalizing it is the thing Porchlight automates.
_about.anchor: Reports run 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-08. Fixed dates, no relative offsets, so every run is identical.
_about.expectations: Each report carries `_expect`. The pipeline ignores it; tests/test_pipeline.py asserts against it. Values: 'silent' (logged, no alert), 'decline' (correlated but deliberately not escalated), 'alert_window' (exactly ONE alert must fire across the reports so tagged — see below).
_about.alert_window: The genuine cluster's 3rd and 4th reports are both defensible alert points: by report 3 there are already 3 distinct reporters in a quiet zone inside 13 hours. Asserting 'the alert fires on report 4' would fail a model making a reasonable call. The test asserts the behavior that actually matters — exactly one alert, and it belongs to the genuine cluster. This requires the pipeline to suppress re-alerting on a cluster that has already alerted; a deployment that re-alerts on every new report spams the recipient into ignoring it.
_about.zone_design: 'Parcel lockers, bldg 3' is deliberately quiet (2 mundane reports over 5 weeks) so the 4-report burst reads as a genuine anomaly. 'Elm St north' and 'Maple & 3rd' are busy, so ordinary activity there does not spike.

reports.text: My package was gone from the porch when I got home Friday. Tracking says it was delivered at 2pm.
Big pothole has opened up near the crossing. Someone is going to bend a wheel on it.
Someone has pulled up half the seedlings in the far bed. They were fine on Sunday.
The street light on the corner has been out for over a week now.
Had a door-to-door caller asking about roof repairs who would not give me a company name.
Bins have been left out blocking the alley again, you cannot get a car through.
Bike gone from the shared rack overnight. It was locked to the frame.
Somebody left a stack of flattened boxes by the lockers instead of taking them round to recycling.
A branch came down in the wind and it is lying half across the footpath.
Fireworks going off late again last night. Woke the baby up twice.
There is fresh graffiti on the side of the substation box, went up overnight.
The hose reel has gone from the shed. Shed was not locked, to be fair.
A car drove up and down the road several times around ten, slowing near the driveways.
The pavement has lifted where the tree roots are. I have tripped on it twice now.
A parcel that was left by the gate has gone. It had been sat there since yesterday.
Wing mirror snapped clean off a parked car overnight. Not the first time on this street.
The drain is blocked and the whole corner floods whenever it rains properly.
The gate has been left unlocked three days running now.
Another delivery has gone missing. Different courier from last time.
Someone was looking into the parked cars along the road earlier. Might be nothing but it seemed odd.
Somebody has kicked in one of the fence panels round the back.
There is ice on the path by the steps and nobody has gritted it.
The planter has been taken from my front step. It was heavy, so it was not one person on their own.
One of the locker doors will not shut properly. It has been like that a while now.
Someone has broken the lock off the tool store. Nothing obviously missing.
A van sat with its engine running for about twenty minutes and then drove off.
The recycling has not been collected on our side of the road for two weeks.
Someone I did not recognise was walking slowly up the street looking at the houses. Probably nothing.
There was a person wandering about near the driveways for a while this afternoon.
Noticed somebody loitering at the end of the road earlier who did not seem to be going anywhere.
The same car has been parked across from my house for three days now.
That vehicle I mentioned is still sat there. Nobody has moved it.
Still there this morning. I do not recognise it and it is not one of the neighbours'.
Car has not moved all week. I am getting a bit fed up of it taking the space.
There has been a guy hanging around the mailboxes the last couple of evenings. Does not live in our building as far as I know.
Saw someone loitering by the post boxes again tonight when I got back from work. Just stood there on their phone.
Somebody was messing about near where the packages get dropped when I left this morning. Could not tell what they were doing.
Person waiting around by the delivery lockers early on again. That is the third time this week someone has brought it up.
